title: Scene 5 · T1 — Beth arrives: 'There's a thing Saturday' / Susan on the bed (SH01–SH02)
line: There's a thing Saturday. Whole group. You're coming. / So everyone can compare me to Paula again? She looks ten years younger than me, Beth. Everyone saw it.
motionPlan: Beth walks in from behind the camera, garment bag over her shoulder, stops in profile between the bed and the dressing table, looks at Susan and says it plainly ; Susan doesn't get up; she says it to her hands
note: Waits for the Scene 5 ingredient cards' Confirm, then one Seedance call.
